name: NeuralLens
tagline: Predicts how a viewer's brain and eyes respond to a marketing asset and iterates the image and copy to improve it.

awards: Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents

problem: Neuromarketing research is priced for the largest brands; small businesses guess what works.
solution: Captures the asset as a viewer would, predicts gaze with DeepGaze and brain response with a research model, then regenerates image and copy until predicted engagement improves.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a menu or flyer and watch scores rise across optimisation rounds.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents” among 307 submissions.
Brings an expensive research method to small businesses.

lessons: Turn a research model into one number a small business owner wants to raise.
